safety_boundaries: Discovery never installs, executes, authenticates, or grants authority.
Lifecycle transitions are explicit and state-validated.
Owner permission is required before capability approval.
Lifecycle events can be persisted without granting authority.
Autonomy observations carry data only and never grant authority.
Cryptographic recovery is independently authorized and replay/tamper/expiry protected.
Canary failure can trigger bounded degradation/rollback, not silent activation.
No unrestricted self-modification or automatic paid acquisition.
